covers.heroAlt: PHOTO · The stone town at the end of the day

text.excerpt: A stone island town you can cross in ten minutes, and a boat out to the islands nearly every morning.
text.intro: Trogir is small enough to walk across in ten minutes and old enough that every one of those minutes passes something worth stopping for. We stayed inside the walls, left by boat most mornings, and came back each evening sunburnt and quiet.

media.caption: Before the day boats arrived, the whole place was ours.

quote.text: Let's get up this early every day

media.caption: Out past the breakwater, every morning.
Water that colour doesn't photograph from the ground.
We stopped counting which bay was which.
The evening we decided to come back in September.

quote.text: Next time, after the boats are gone
